units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:14">Tosef. Shebi. III, 14</cite> <he>שתהא קִיצָתָהּ שוה</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>שיהא קִיצָתוֹ</he>) that the felling be even (the stumps all alike, v. <cite ref="D01035"><he>דָּרַג</he></cite>); Y. ib. IV, 35ᵇ bot. <he>קיצצתן</he> (corr. acc., or <he>קְצִיצָתָן</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 4:7">Tosef. Keth. IV, 7</cite> <he>אין כלום לאחר הק׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>הקיצא</he>) after this agreement (that she would support herself and her husband) there can be no claim; Y. ib. V, 29ᵈ <cite ref="S01586"><he>קניין</he></cite> (corr. acc.).—Y. ib. IV, 29ᵃ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 9:4:3">Y. B. Bath. IX, 17ᵃ</cite> top <he>מכה שיש לה ק׳</he> a disease on the treatment of which there is a definite agreement (with the physician as to his charge), v. <cite ref="S01786"><he>קִצְבָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 6:6">Tosef. Keth. VI, 6</cite> <he>אם עשתה קִיצָתָהּ</he> if she made her own stipulation, v. <cite ref="S01132"><he>קִיצוּתָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 8b:8">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>על קִיצָתָן</he>, v. <cite ref="N00954"><he>נָסַע</he></cite>.
